description: Decode a Chia 'offer1...' string locally (no external API). Returns a structured trade summary: what assets are offered, what is requested, and per-asset amounts and IDs. Classifies XCH, CATs (with asset_id), NFTs (with launcher_id), and DIDs.

offer.description: A Chia offer string starting with 'offer1'. Bech32m-encoded.

name: decode_offer
